about.title: About me
about.description: A bit about my journey from Paraguay to Brazil, and what drives me in front-end development.
about.p1: I'm passionate about technology, focused on front-end development. I'm in my third year of Software Engineering and have solid experience with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Styled-Components.
about.p2: I'm originally from Paraguay, born in Asunción, and I've been living in Brazil for two years, improving my skills in web development.
about.p3: My journey in programming started with a genuine interest in building impactful, intuitive digital experiences. Over time I grew a strong affinity for front-end, where I can combine creativity and technical skills to build modern, efficient user interfaces.
about.p4: Beyond front-end, I have back-end knowledge with Node.js, which helps me understand and collaborate effectively on full-stack projects.
about.p5: I'm always looking for new challenges and opportunities to learn and grow. Feel free to explore my projects and get in touch for collaborations or to learn more about my work.
